privacy.deleteAccountDescription: Close your account and erase your personal data. Some purchase records are kept as required by law.
privacy.firstConfirmMessage:
Your email, phone, addresses, photo, saved cards, favorites and unsold listings are deleted right away.

Your orders, payments and disputes are kept blocked for up to 5 years for legal and tax obligations. Your public reviews remain as "Usuario eliminado".

You can register again with the same email later.
privacy.secondConfirmMessage: Type the word ELIMINAR to confirm you want to delete your account.
privacy.reauthPasswordMessage: For your security, enter your password to delete your account.
privacy.reauthGoogleMessage: For your security, sign in with Google again to delete your account.
